For a first grade Chinese library-corner class. Fine tactile paper grain, opaque matte gouache, clean cut-paper contours, deep pine and warm cream, apricot, persimmon and faded teal accents; warm, quiet child-eye storytelling. Same illustration style in all four cells. Top left: at a tiny school library table, three Chinese primary-school children warmly prepare craft bookmarks near an empty tray, a girl with dark bob and apricot sweater, a boy with dark cropped hair and sage shirt, another child in cream. Bottom left: a library reading nook with pale floor and furniture only far left and right, broad open center for a cart crossing board, full-width gentle environment, no people or prominent countable props. All crops maintain the same paper material and hue, quiet backgrounds and clean characters.
